Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misread and reported the SEC headquarters city as Jackson, Mississippi despite visible authoritative cues on the search results page (SECU contact address and Wikipedia snippet) indicating Birmingham, Alabama. This reflects reliance on an incorrect snippet and failure to verify with authoritative sources, introducing the core factual error that drove the subsequent confusion.
